units.source_text: 就这样中了土蜘蛛的圈套，发长彦后悔万分。

en.t: In this way, Hotsunagahiko had fallen into the earth spider's trap and bitterly regretted it.

units.source_text: 幸亏他记得他别在腰间的笛子。

en.t: Fortunately, he remembered the flute he had tucked at his waist.

units.source_text: 只要吹响笛子，笛声就会让飞禽走兽、花草树木沉醉其中。

en.t: If he only sounded the flute, its music would enchant the birds and beasts, the flowers, grasses, and trees.

units.source_text: 因此，那个坏心眼的土蜘蛛也不一定不动心。

en.t: So even that malicious earth spider might not be unmoved.

units.source_text: 于是，发长彦再次鼓起勇气，一面吹响笛子，一面安抚狂吠的三只狗。

en.t: Then Hotsunagahiko gathered his courage once more, sounding the flute while soothing the three dogs that were barking wildly.
